column1: # AUR Vetting rule catalogue (ADR 0143). One rule per record, TAB-separated:
# severity: critical (always aborts) | suspicious (asks, or aborts unattended,
# unless allowlisted for the package) | info (logged). A trailing backslash
# continues a record on the next line, dropping exactly one leading TAB (so a
# line opening with two TABs starts the next field).
#   code     every tracked text file but .SRCINFO, minus comments and
#   install  *.install scriptlets (run as root by pacman)
#   builtin  engine-coded check; ERE is `-`, severity/description live here
# unless: a line matching it is skipped (e.g. echo'd instructions).
